purpose: 重新掃描既有 Dawn 攝取層，恢復此前沒有被統一編目的中文與中文本地化資源；先分流，再決定是否進中文館藏。
discoverySignals: language/locale fields: zh, zh-Hans, zh-Hant, Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
source-level Chinese localization even when the Dawn source record itself is not language-indexed
Chinese metadata attached to multilingual Bible-world datasets

buckets.bible-world-zh: 中文或中文本地化的聖經、查經、聖經地理/人物/路線/地圖/圖像/年代/背景資料；不計入黎明書局中文館藏。
buckets.zh-non-bible: 中文可閱讀、非普通 Bible-study/reference 的作品候選；進 identity/provenance/rights/admission 管線後才可成為中文館藏 canonical member。
buckets.zh-metadata-only: 只有中文 metadata/localization、沒有可作為中文作品閱讀的內容；保留作 discovery/search 能力，不計作中文館藏作品。

confirmedLegacySignalsSoFar.note: 兩個和合本 edition 已知，從中文館藏作品統計剝離。
多語 Bible-world source；需要 item-level 恢復中文 metadata/localization，不能當黎明書局中文作品。
Bible geography source；中文化結果歸 Emmaus 規劃。

bulkScanObservation: Existing bulk acquisition directory contains many source-level acquisition manifests (IIIF, Christian corpora, historical text corpora, art corpora and related sources), but repository-wide code search does not expose a reliable unified Chinese language marker. Therefore recovery must inspect source manifests and source capabilities rather than equating absence of a zh code-search hit with absence of Chinese resources.
promotionRule: Recovery is not admission. A recovered zh-non-bible item becomes a canonical 中文館藏 member only after identity, provenance, rights, duplicate and Dawn admission checks pass.
next: Inspect each legacy source manifest for multilingual/Chinese coverage, produce item/source recovery candidates, then merge and deduplicate against the newly established 中文館藏 pipeline.
